name: coder-claude-code
title: Claude Code (headless)
description: Anthropic's Claude Code run headless by the executor: the brief on stdin, least-privilege tools, JSON result. Default for Hermann.
notes: Placeholders: ${model}, ${allowedTools}, ${maxTurns}. The prompt is piped on stdin (a quoted -p argument can lose its quotes through the executor chain).

name: coder-codex
title: OpenAI Codex CLI (headless)
description: OpenAI's Codex CLI in non-interactive exec mode with a workspace-write sandbox; the brief on stdin, plain-text result. Present on the host when check-infra reports it; not exercised by Hermann's own proof.
notes: Codex has no allowed-tools flag; the sandbox limits it to the repository. Edit this token to change the command.
